message.content: {"note_claim": "The Space Shuttle Columbia disaster killed all seven crew members on board.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana, killing all seven astronauts on board.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page directly confirms that Columbia broke apart during reentry and killed all seven crew members, substantiating the note's claim about the photo depicting the Columbia disaster."}

parsed.note_claim: The Space Shuttle Columbia disaster killed all seven crew members on board.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana, killing all seven astronauts on board.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page directly confirms that Columbia broke apart during reentry and killed all seven crew members, substantiating the note's claim about the photo depicting the Columbia disaster.
